pages.about: Cedar & Loom is a weaving studio of four people working two floor looms and a small stitching bench. We buy undyed yarn, weave to order where we can, and dye in small batches with plant dyes. Nothing in the range is made anywhere other than our own studio.
pages.refund_policy: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery, unused and in original packaging, for a full refund to the original payment method. Made-to-order pieces are exempt unless faulty. Faulty goods are replaced or refunded in full including return postage.
pages.shipping_policy: Orders dispatched within 3 business days. Standard delivery is 3-5 business days at $7.00, free over $150. Express delivery is 1-2 business days at $18.00. Larger blankets ship in a single box regardless of quantity.
